name: dependency-firewall
description: Check whether a package/version is safe to add, and diagnose an install or build failure caused by Harness Dependency Firewall (artifact_scan / firewall_exception), for any package type. Covers listing registries/packages/versions, CVE/license/policy checks, fix-version suggestions, and firewall exception lifecycle. Use when a user asks whether a package is safe to add ("can I use dayjs?"), or an install or build fails with a 403 on a Harness registry artifact — worth checking even if the error doesn't say "firewall". Also covers "no matching version", "blocked by policy", and "my exception was approved but it still fails". Do NOT use for Docker pulls (firewall not enabled there) or generic registry auth errors. Not for STO/SCS security exemptions (a different resource, `security_exemption`) — this skill is scoped to registry artifact firewall exceptions only. Trigger phrases: dependency firewall, is this package safe, package blocked by policy, firewall exception, 403 on install, fix version available.
